args.reason: Need the earnings prep workflow steps before applying them to AAPL Estimate History.

args.data: Apply Finance Earnings Prep to the AAPL Estimate History widget (widget_id: estimate_history, symbol: AAPL). Use the quarterly EPS and revenue estimate fields—quarter, eps_estimate, and revenue_estimate_b—to compare internal estimates to street numbers. Identify potential surprise drivers by looking for changes in EPS Estimate and Revenue Estimate ($B) across quarters. Review guidance and inspect transcript tone alongside this estimate history to explain why consensus may be moving. Produce action items for the portfolio manager based on estimate revisions, guidance risk, transcript tone, and thesis risks.
args.description: Workflow note applying finance-earnings-prep to AAPL Estimate History.
